name: Hoa Lo Prison
kicker: The remaining prison at 1 Hoa Lo
summary: Walk the remaining cells and yard of Hoa Lo, the prison whose gate still reads Maison Centrale, at 1 Hoa Lo, south of the lake. It is open every day, holidays included, with no lunch break, so it fills the midday gap when other museums close.
heroCaption: The Maison Centrale gate at Hoa Lo

notice.title: No lunch closing
notice.body: The gate is open 8:00 to 17:00 every day, including holidays, with no lunch break.

body: The visit is the remaining prison buildings and the yard at 1 Hoa Lo, Cua Nam ward. The gate still carries the Maison Centrale name.
Give it a morning or an early afternoon. Because it does not close at noon, it is the stop to keep for the hours when the history museum is shut. Under 16 is free.

figures.caption: The same gate, with visitors at the entrance
figures.alt: Visitors at the Hoa Lo prison gate in Hanoi

gettingThere: The address is 1 Hoa Lo, Cua Nam. Walk south from Hoan Kiem Lake.
hours: 8:00–17:00 every day, including holidays. No lunch break.
admissionNote: Adult 50,000 VND. Half price 25,000 VND for the groups the relic lists. Free under 16.
